items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. The interviewee (Christine Jensen) does not mention any personal or professional relationship with him in the provided text.

ctx.x: Christine was interviewed via Zoom on March 4, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m at Hamilton College and I’m pleased to be speaking with Christine Jensen who is at Eastman. I want to congratulate you on your career thus far.
